authorisation: Eric, 2026-11-19 15:01 UTC: Kane first (one objective call), then exactly 240 offline games on fresh seeds 62101-62130, 0 external calls, 0 further Kane calls, no promotion.
freezeRule: This file and the matrix are hashed into balance/v3/journal.ndjson BEFORE the Kane call. Kane's proposals are mapped onto these arms afterwards. The arms, the seed set, the 240-game total and the comparisons below are not changed after seeing Kane's output or any validation result. A proposal that would need a different allocation is recorded as NOT_TESTED.

C.role: does the screen's C4 signal replicate (HC0 vs HC1); control for D

D.role: starting rules vs planner evaluation (HC1 vs HC2)

metrics.more_pieces_side_win_rate: wins of the side that started with more pieces / decisive games (unequal arms only)
metrics.conveyor_per_game: own-trap triggers that carried the stepping piece forward, per game
metrics.self_trigger_share: triggers on the stepping side's own traps / all triggers
metrics.turn1_score_rate: games in which the first mover had a piece across at the end of turn 1 / games
metrics.comeback_rate: decisive games won by a side that trailed after turn 4 / decisive games
metrics.unused_cell_rate: trap cells never triggered / cells placed

statistics.difference: treated minus control, paired by seed: a seed's two games (both first movers) move together. 95% interval from 5000 seeded bootstrap resamples of the 30 seeds (seed 62100).

predictionRule.increase/decrease: met = the difference in the predicted direction is at least minEffect AND its 95% interval excludes 0; contradicted = the interval's bound in the predicted direction is below minEffect (an effect of the predicted size is excluded); otherwise unclear
predictionRule.no-change: met = the whole 95% interval lies within [-minEffect, +minEffect]; contradicted = the interval excludes 0 and |difference| >= minEffect; otherwise unclear

statistics.hypothesisRule: SUPPORTED = every tested prediction met; REFUTED = at least one contradicted; INCONCLUSIVE = otherwise; NOT_TESTED = none of its predictions can be measured under its intervention by arms A-D. SUPPORTED means the predictions held on these seeds, not proof.

HC0.test: absolute criteria on arm C, first_mover_win_rate

predictions.note: C's rate must be at most 0.35 with the Wilson upper bound below 0.5

HC3.reason: needs P1 (partial own-benefit search); no arm runs it

HC4.reason: needs S3 (turn-1 action cap); no arm runs it. Arm B reports whether first-mover tempo remains without RNG foresight, which bears on HC4 but does not test its intervention.

HD1.reason: needs S4 (second-mover bonus); no arm runs it

mapping.kane: Kane proposals registered after the call are mapped by the same rules: a prediction is tested only if its metric is measured by one of the comparisons above under the proposal's own intervention (or observationally, if it names none). Everything else is NOT_TESTED.

foresight: Independent of win rates: for every teleport a piece triggers, the real engine re-runs that move from the pre-move state with 200 seeded random RNG states, which gives the squares a blind (non-foreseeing) step onto that teleport would gain on average. Realized minus blind-expected gain, in A (and the screen) versus B, measures how much information the planner extracts from the engine RNG. Reported as an information-access fairness question whatever the win-rate tests show.
reported: Safety (illegal, errors, softlocks), length (mean turns, turn-limit rate), counterplay and diversity for B and D versus their controls are reported for context. Nothing is promoted.
